title: State v. Smith (N.J. 1994)
key_points: Holding: An officer may order a passenger out of a stopped vehicle only with specific and articulable facts that would warrant heightened caution.
officer_notes: Scenario: During a nighttime stop the passenger keeps reaching under the seat after being told to keep hands visible. You order him out.
Takeaway: Document the facts that raised your concern about the passenger.
